description: Generate and maintain the system recap block in a PR description - a GitHub-rendered visual summary of which system primitives a change touches, how risky it is, and what changed. Prefer mermaid sequence diagrams for the change; pick another graph type when it explains the diff better. Use when planning a non-trivial change (plan mode), when creating or updating a pull request (recap mode), or when the user asks for a visual recap, visual plan, system review, or PR recap.
